result.finding: Single custom bridge network 'photoalbum-network' connecting both services (oracle-db and photoalbum-java-app) for internal communication. Application port 8080 and Oracle port 1521 exposed to host.
evidence: docker-compose.yml top-level networks: photoalbum-network with driver: bridge
Inter-service DNS: app connects to Oracle via hostname 'oracle-db' within the network
values: Internal DNS resolution: oracle-db hostname used in SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL
